methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Bubble Robotics is a private robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jean Crosetti and Patricia Apostol. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms. Notable private comparables include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median method is not applicable in this case. The dataset identified zero companies meeting narrow stage-aligned or valuation-tier-aligned filters necessary for reliable triangulation. While 11 same-sector peers exist, filtering by stage proximity and comparable valuation tier yielded insufficient matches—below the minimum threshold of three datapoints required for statistical validity. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial selection bias and misrepresent the target's true peer set.

Without a sufficiently deep comparable set filtered by stage and scale, quantitative valuation methods cannot be reliably executed. A credible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. Further diligence would require either (1) identifying additional private or public robotics companies at similar growth stages and valuations, or (2) supplementing with income or asset-based approaches if the company's financial metrics or IP portfolio can be assessed. The single public comparable and fragmented private set do not provide adequate anchoring for a triangulated valuation at this time.
